title: United States, Croatia Sign Protocol to Income Tax Treaty
summary: The U.S. and Croatia signed a protocol amending their 2022 income tax treaty, incorporating technical amendments to bring the treaty into conformity with current U.S. law and Senate preferences, including coordination with provisions of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act of 2025. The protocol will be transmitted to the Senate for advice and consent to ratification.
key_points: Protocol signed April 28, 2026 on margins of Three Seas Initiative Summit in Dubrovnik
Amends the 2022 U.S.-Croatia income tax treaty (first such treaty between the two nations)
Adopts a treaty-based definition of 'active conduct of a trade or business' for Article 22 (Limitation on Benefits)
Revises Article 23 (Relief from Double Taxation) rules regarding U.S. obligations
Amends Article 24 (Non-Discrimination) to coordinate with provisions of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act of 2025
Protocol requires Senate advice and consent and exchange of notifications to enter into force
